field_verifications.proposed_value: 13 cytokine concentrations in stimulated culture supernatants; beads analyzed by flow cytometry
field_verifications.evidence_text: Cytokines in cell culture supernatants of the same samples used for AIM were quantified using a human Th cytokine panel (13-plex) kit (LEGENDplex, Biolegend) according to the manufacturer’s instruction. Supernatants were mixed with beads coated with capture antibodies specific for IL-5, IL-13, IL-2, IL-6, IL-9, IL-10, IFNγ, TNFα, IL-17a, IL-17F, IL-4, IL-21 and IL-22 and incubated on a 96 well filter plate for 2 hours. Beads were analyzed by flow cytometry using a FACS Canto cytometer. Analysis was performed using the LEGENDplex analysis software v8.0, which distinguishes between the 13 different analytes on basis of bead size and internal dye.
field_verifications.reason: The text explicitly states 13 cytokine analytes were quantified in supernatants and the beads were analyzed by flow cytometry.
